description: Source code for the front panel control in a media device, managing LED indicators, brightness, blinking patterns, and clock display settings.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Main class managing front panel indicators, brightness, blinking, and preferences.

classes.name: FrontPanelHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing remote LED state.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Structure representing blinking pattern information for LEDs.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for CFrontPanel instance, initializes indicators and power state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the front panel service, initializes indicator list.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops blinking timer and halts front panel activity.

methods.name: setPowerStatus
methods.description: Sets the current power status of the device.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of all front panel indicators.

methods.name: getBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the current brightness level.

methods.name: setClockBrightness
methods.description: Sets the clock display brightness (if enabled).

methods.name: getClockBrightness
methods.description: Gets the current clock display brightness.

methods.name: powerOnLed
methods.description: Turns on specified LED indicator.

methods.name: powerOffLed
methods.description: Turns off specified LED indicator.

methods.name: remoteLedOn
methods.description: Turns on the remote indicator LED.

methods.name: remoteLedOff
methods.description: Turns off the remote indicator LED.

methods.name: powerOffAllLed
methods.description: Turns off all LEDs.

methods.name: powerOnAllLed
methods.description: Turns on all LEDs.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Sets specific LED indicator with brightness and color.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Configures blinking pattern for LEDs.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves current front panel preferences.

methods.name: setPreferences
methods.description: Saves front panel preferences to file.

methods.name: loadPreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from file.

methods.name: startBlinkTimer
methods.description: Starts blinking timer with specified repeat count.

methods.name: stopBlinkTimer
methods.description: Stops blinking timer.

methods.name: setBlinkLed
methods.description: Sets LED state for blinking pattern.

methods.name: onBlinkTimer
methods.description: Callback for blinking timer to toggle LEDs.

methods.name: set24HourClock
methods.description: Configures clock display format to 24-hour.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if clock is in 24-hour format.
